caption: Each morning, one tap on how you feel.
say: Assalamu alaikum, I'm QK. Each morning, just tap how you feel.

caption: Then one clear next step. Today: the workout.
say: Then the app shows you one thing: your next step. Today, it's your workout.

caption: QK shows where to put the phone.
say: I'll show you exactly where to put your phone.

caption: QK watches every rep, counts it and coaches one cue at a time.
say: I watch every rep through the camera, count it, and coach you one cue at a time.

caption: Feet too far forward → QK cues it → the fix is praised.
say: Feet too far forward? I'll tell you. Fix it, and I'll tell you that too.

caption: Form score, one thing to fix, and the rest timer starts by itself.
say: After every set: your form score, one thing to fix, and your rest timer starts by itself.

caption: Over 200 exercises when you want something else.
say: Want to train something else? There are over two hundred exercises to choose from.

caption: Everything else lives under All tools.
say: Everything else lives under All tools, so it's there when you need it.

caption: Pain or injury? A safe, step-by-step rehab plan.
say: Got pain or an injury? You get a safe, step-by-step rehab plan.

caption: Fingertip on the camera: heart rate, HRV and your 7-day trend.
say: Put your fingertip on the camera to check your heart rate and recovery, and see your seven-day trend.

caption: When your mind is racing: Sukoon.
say: And when your mind is racing, there's Sukoon.

caption: One tap: how tense do you feel?
say: Tap how tense you feel.

caption: Breathe slowly with the circle, eyes closed if you like.
say: Breathe slowly with the circle. Close your eyes if you like.

caption: Listen to a short recitation from the Quran.
say: Then listen to a short recitation from the Quran.

caption: Finish with a dua from the Sunnah.
say: And finish with a dua from the Sunnah.

caption: See what really calms you down.
say: Over time, you'll see what really calms you down.

caption: Brain: a score for how well you looked after your brain this week.
say: And to keep your brain sharp, there's Brain. Your Brain score shows how well you looked after it this week.

caption: Speed Flash: spot the car, find the star. The drill with long-term evidence.
say: Speed Flash is the brain drill with twenty years of evidence behind it.

caption: Reflex games, the way F1 drivers train. Lights Out: react to the start.
say: And reflex games, the way F1 drivers train. Lights out, and go!

caption: Reaction Wall, like the Batak board: hit every light in 30 seconds.
say: Hit every light you can in thirty seconds.

caption: Learn the Quran by heart: listen, fade the words, recite from memory.
say: Learn the Quran by heart. Listen, fade the words, and recite from memory.

caption: Each verse comes back for review just before you'd forget it.
say: And each verse comes back for review, just before you'd forget it.

caption: Read the whole Quran: all 114 surahs, with translation.
say: And you can read the whole Quran here. All one hundred and fourteen surahs, with the translation.

caption: Listen as it follows along, bookmark, and continue where you left off.
say: Press play and it follows along with the recitation. And it remembers where you stopped.

caption: Your progress, all in one place.
say: Your progress is all in one place.

caption: One tap sends QK your week. Text only, never video.
say: And with one tap, you send me your week, so I can coach you properly.

caption: Your coach in your pocket.
say: Shred. Your coach in your pocket. Let's get to work.
